_meta.what: Job 7's opponent ladder. One BRACKET per set. Nothing in here names the set it unlocks or its own position — buildLadder() in src/progress.js derives both from the live-set order, so a bracket for a set that is not live simply does not appear, and a live set with no bracket here gets a generated one automatically. Adding Team Rocket is adding a key, or adding nothing at all.
_meta.deck refs: 'theme:NAME' is DECKS in cards.js (data/decks.json). 'gbc:KEY' and 'jungle:NAME' are OPPONENT_DECKS (data/gbc_decks.json, data/jungle_decks.json). 'generate' is a pool spec handed to deckgen at match time, seeded off the opponent id so the same challenger always brings the same deck.
_meta.names: GBC characters keep their real names. Anything marked placeholder:true is ours and is meant to be replaced — Trevor's note, 12 Aug 2026: the decks and names are easily reshapable, the structure is what has to be right.
_meta.ronald: Ronald is the recurring rival, one deck per bracket in the order the GBC escalates them. His fourth, ronald_legendary, is the post-boss challenge in the last authored bracket; when a fourth set goes live it should probably move to being that bracket's boss instead.
_meta.unassigned: No GBC deck is unused. All 16 appear exactly once.
